provenance.artifact_note: Artifact names identify the original private analysis notes, not files distributed with this source. The APK and disassembly are not bundled; function addresses and binary hashes preserve the technical provenance.

common.dio_extra_note: Local Dio interceptor metadata; it is not itself an HTTP header or query parameter.
common.authorization_note: These methods request token attachment by the interceptor. Authorization header construction is not repeated in these cart methods.
common.concurrency_note: No revision, ETag or idempotency field is present in the confirmed request maps below. Shared interceptors and server behavior were not proved to provide concurrency protection.
common.retry_note: A response lost after a mutation is uncertain. Do not infer safe automatic mutation retries from the use of PUT.

CartItem.identity_note: CartItem.itemId is the row's explicit operation identifier. Do not substitute platformItem.id without verifying identity equivalence.

PutCartResponse.ui_check: 0x5c540c..0x5c554c checks status and shows the response message on failure; HTTP200 alone is not operation success.

representation_notes.prices: Cart monetary values are preserved in raw API units in MCP cart results. Product price display divides the raw number by100 and appends the tenge sign; this is independently proven in catalog-protocol-evidence.json at0x64e134. Product MCP results expose price_raw and Decimal-derived price_kzt. Do not apply a guessed scale to cart weight/quantity fields.
representation_notes.quantity: PUT /cart/v2/item sends an absolute integer target in the product API units, not a delta. The UI changes targets by ProductMeasureUnit.step; zero uses DELETE /cart/item with a JSON itemId body. No universal kilograms-to-quantity conversion is established.
representation_notes.row_identity: Use the explicit CartItem.itemId for writes. Product.itemId from a search/category result is also the argument to the normal product-detail route /catalog/client/platformItem/{item_id}; the separate /platformItem/item/{item_id}?platformId route belongs to the app deep-link branch.
representation_notes.verification: This evidence was recovered statically. This analysis sent no cart mutations or other live requests.
